title: The One It Is Done To
label: ch:ta-ai
canDo: I can mark the object of a verb with -ai, say me and you as objects, and tell when the ending is compulsory and when it is a choice that means 'the'.

payoff.summary: From cold: the accusative ending and which end of the word it sits on, the two pronoun objects and the changed bodies they stand on, and the one question — is the object a person — that decides whether the ending may be left off.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. Every example keeps a FIRST-PERSON SUBJECT: the lessons have third-person objects, and the third-person ending -aar appears once in the whole track, so a first-person subject keeps each example inside what the reader has been taught.
